newsitem.title: USA: DLB says hires Lehman as financial agent.
newsitem.headline: DLB says hires Lehman as financial agent.

text.p: DLB Oil & Gas Inc said it has hired Lehman Brothers Inc to act as its financial agent in exploring strategic alternatives.
Those alternatives could include the sale of specific assets or activities of the company, DLB said.
DLB Oil & Gas Inc is an Oklahoma City-based independent energy company engaged primarily in oil and gas exploration, development and production and in the acquisition of producing properties.
No further information was immediately available.
